description: Official documentation of Vertigo, a Java platform for building business applications: concepts, configuration, Vertigo Core, Vertigo Libs extensions (UI, REST, search, security), modules, connectors and Vertigo Studio.
rules: Configure a Vertigo node and its modules and features in the application's YAML configuration file; do not activate features with the Java *Features builder DSL.
managers.xml, XMLAppConfigBuilder and io.vertigo.dynamo packages are obsolete (before Vertigo 3); never use them in new code.
Entities, domains and tasks are declared in KSP files and generated by Vertigo Studio (MDA); do not hand-edit generated classes.
